digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate: context-limit escalation and model ladder resolution
propositions: models_at_or_above() falls through to return the full ladder for any primary not matching an Anthropic family name substring, exposing the caller to escalation downgrades and provider-family jumps.

Pass-1 escalation via sizing.py:378-386 assigns returned ladder names directly to config, so an unlocated non-Anthropic primary triggers escalation to claude-haiku-4-5 (smaller window, different provider) as its first retry.

largest_window_tokens() returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] (1000000) for any unlocated primary, overstating the available window and causing P8 under-blocking and silent truncation instead of explicit _too_big failure findings.
prerequisite-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260-261 takes ladder[0] for an unlocated primary, reproducing the same downgrade and cross-family jump without editing that file.

For a truthy-but-unlocated model, models_at_or_above() must return [model] (preserving single-criterion retry) and largest_window_tokens() must return the ladder minimum (conservative fallback) rather than silent wrong answers.
